facts.text: We discussed an instrument called the astrolabe.
I asked who invented the astrolabe.
I asked what need or idea in humans of the era could have sparked the basis for inventing the astrolabe.
I asked whether the astrolabe was an advanced instrument for its times or whether similar instruments were available and it was just an upgraded version.
I asked what BCE means in the phrase “The origins of the astrolabe are not well documented, but it is believed to have been invented in the Hellenistic world around 150 BCE.”
I asked what Anno Domini means.
I asked whether there is no Latin phrase for BC but there is a Latin phrase for AD.
I asked for a speech to students about the astrolabe that includes humorous anecdotes about the invention or its use and a funny incident involving malfunctioning and erroneous readings.
I created a series of paintings using 3D and AI to assist in my projects about the astrolabe.
My art project morphs the human face with parts and drawings and reading from an astrolabe.
My creative venture outlines how humans have built instruments and machines from the Hellenistic ages and even before that to aid and assist our living.
